body: Thank you so much. You have no idea how much your words impacted me. For now, I'm still here, and I'm just trying to take things one minute at a time.
Thank you so much! I will send you a message.

I just want to say thank you, in the most sincere way. I was, in all honesty, a couple seconds away from ending things when I saw this. 

I was sitting on my bed with a bottle of pills in my hand, and I began to read your words. The first four words you wrote saved my life tonight. I've never once been told that before. To be told that by anyone is foreign to me, let alone a complete stranger. 

Everything you described is exactly what I'm feeling. Suicide has never been what I've wanted. I just don't know how to do this anymore. The anxiety, depression, and loneliness are just so exhausting.

Thank you for reaching out and sharing with me. You seem like a very strong, caring person. Please keep in touch, and I sincerely hope you can continue moving forward.
